name: NFTTOOLS API DOCS FOR SATFLOW
description:
API documentation for accessing Satflow Bitcoin Ordinals & Runes marketplace via NFTTools proxy.

## Backend tRPC API
The backend uses tRPC with batch support. Query procedures use GET with URL-encoded JSON input params.
Mutation procedures use POST with JSON body. All tRPC calls support batching via `?batch=1`.

### tRPC Input Format
For GET queries, input is passed as URL-encoded JSON in the `input` query parameter:
```
?batch=1&input={"0":{"json":{...}}}
```
For POST mutations, input is sent as JSON body:
```json
{"json": {...}}
```

### tRPC Response Format
Responses are wrapped in tRPC result envelope: `{"result":{"data":{"json":{...}}}}`
Batch responses return arrays of these. The `_meta.ms` field in each response indicates server processing time.

## Memflow API
REST API for mempool flow data, charts, and collection analytics.
Memflow endpoints use a separate base URL (see per-path server overrides).
